text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first half of the year's Twinkle
Series
ends with Biwa Hayahide's
tremendous
victory in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now with summer here, Team Sirius goes
shopping to prepare for
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, there's fireworks, watermelon,
carrots... Aaah, we've got so
much to buy!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Prepping for camp is hard,
but we'll have a
chance to stretch our legs once we get
there. It's a training camp,
but this is also a vacation for us.

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's really her! It was so amazing to
see you win the Derby with
that
five-length lead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Thanks...

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the third crown, the Kikuka
Sho, right? Are you gonna race
the Arima
Kinen after that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was wondering that too! Well,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's set in stone yet,
but I'm thinking
that'll be the schedule.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's set in stone yet,
but I'm thinking
that'll be the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Seeing you take the Triple Crown
and go on to win the Arima
Kinen would
be amazing! We've got high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me.
I'm going to win
all my races.

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! I'm gonna go watch you with my
family! We can't wait to see
your big win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is confident in her victory. She
deserves nothing less.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, it's hard to imagine her losing.
At Brian's level, she's got
both the Kikuka
Sho and the Arima Kinen in the bag.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Though depending on her opponents,
things might get shaken up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But who could win against her?
Oh? Well, if it isn't Brian.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She's Hishi Amazon, the leader of the
Miho dorm. Doing a little
shopping,
Amazon?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the juniors aren't goin' home for
summer, so I thought I'd make
a little treat
for them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
They're gonna start calling you dorm mom
instead...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, taking care of people isn't just
about
feeding 'em.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I set an example on the track too.
Whoever you face, you can take
'em on if
you've got the guts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Hishi Amazon's got the same
never-fail attitude as
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Screeeech!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew, too close for comfort.

text_block_list.name: Shopper's Child
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Uwaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't you know to look both ways
before crossin' the road?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've got ol' Hishiama watchin' your back
this time, so let's see you
try that again
safely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shopper's Child
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Thanks, miss...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nice moves, Ama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, I wouldn't be a good dorm
leader if I didn't watch out for
the kids.
Now... where were we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian,
I'd love to race you out on the track.
A battle to see who's
really the best racer!
Sounds good?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
One day we'll race each other, so don't go
runnin' away on me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd never run from a race, but I have no
intention of waiting. If you
want it so bad,
you'll have to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's the spirit! Anyway, I'm gonna
hit up the egg sale. Later!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Like I said, dorm mom.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that almost made my heart stop.
Seeing her bust that speed
outta nowhere
to save that kid was even more surprising
though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Have you never seen her race before? It's
a sight to behold when she
charges from
the back to the very front near
instantaneously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Some say it's even more impressive than
Brian's races.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
With Brian on the radar of a racer like
her,
we're not lacking in worthy
opponents.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
With Brian on the radar of a racer like
her,
we're not lacking in worthy
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So! We're having our summer camp at the
Mejiro villa. You two wanna
come?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry,
but I'll have to pass. I got injured
before the Takarazuka Kinen,
so I'll be
visiting the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Awww... That's a shame.
Looks like it's just
me and you, Hayahide!
You're in, right?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, count me out as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa?! But there's gonna be fireworks
and watermelon and carrots!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I have something that needs
attending to.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you're working on summer
homework. Is that what
you've been
scribbling in your notebook?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what is this?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Muscle and core training...
Sprints on dirt and ramps... Gate training
and pool
training... wow, the notebook's completely
filled!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No way, you're gonna do all this stuff for summer?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am.
I need to prepare for the races in the
fall—both the All Comers
and the Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then finally... I'll hit the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're going for the Arima Kinen?! That
means you and Brian are
gonna be in the
same race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A worthy opponent...
